candidates.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
candidates.title_zh: 感觉运动对齐：具身策略成功的柏拉图式代理指标
candidates.abstract: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出免训练离线指标S²，衡量模型感官表征与物理运动几何的对齐程度，并在多种具身模型上验证其与机器人任务成功率正相关，可用于闭环评估前筛选模型与VLM骨干。
candidates.contribution_zh: 将柏拉图表征假设扩展到具身模型，提出可测量的感觉运动对齐指标，为VLA/WAM表现提供表征层面解释。

provenance.source_comment: 28 pages. Project page and code available at https://yunfeixie233.github.io/s2/

ai_review.reason: 提出面向具身策略的离线表征对齐指标，直接服务机器人模型评估与筛选。

candidates.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
candidates.title_zh: 通过视频阅读、书写、共享与交互世界
candidates.abstract: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.
candidates.summary_zh: 该综述以世界模型为统一视角，将视频视为潜在时序世界的部分投影，围绕读、写、共享、交互四类操作梳理视频基础模型与世界模型。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提出以世界建模统一视频理解与生成的框架，区分序列时序一致性与潜在世界状态一致性，并总结数据、基准与开放挑战。

ai_review.reason: 综述以世界模型统一视频理解与生成，涵盖动作条件预测和交互，直接关联物理智能。

candidates.title: DiffDreamer: Coupling World Models with Differentiable Simulation for Agile Quadrotor Control
candidates.title_zh: DiffDreamer：耦合世界模型与可微仿真实现敏捷四旋翼控制
candidates.abstract: Tasks such as quadrotor dynamic-gate racing require agents to anticipate external motion while maintaining precise high-frequency control. World-model-based reinforcement learning provides a natural solution by learning latent dynamics for future imagination, yet it often entangles environmental evolution and the robot's own dynamics in a single learned rollout, where model bias can affect policy optimization efficiency. We propose DiffDreamer, a differentiable reinforcement learning framework that tightly couples a learned world model with differentiable simulation for actor optimization. In one optimization step, the learned world model propagates latent states that capture external dynamics and history-dependent features, while the differentiable simulator propagates the robot's explicit physical state. We further decompose the actor objective into a critic-driven pathway for non-differentiable task rewards and a simulator-driven pathway for differentiable motion rewards. Experiments on aggressive tracking and dynamic-gate racing show that DiffDreamer improves training convergence over the model-free, model-based, and differentiable-RL baselines, and final performance over these baselines and classical planning and control methods. Additional experiments assess reward decomposition and the odometry-conditioned relative-state representation through ablations. We also provide proof-of-concept real-world flight experiments for validation.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出可微强化学习框架，将学习到的潜空间世界模型与可微仿真紧耦合：世界模型推演外部动态与历史特征，仿真器传播机器人显式物理状态，并分解演员目标以兼顾任务奖励与可微运动奖励。
candidates.contribution_zh: 分离环境演化与机器人自身动力学建模，结合可微仿真优化策略，在激进跟踪与动态门竞速中提升收敛与最终性能，并完成真机验证。

ai_review.reason: 面向四旋翼敏捷控制，耦合学习世界模型与可微仿真，属机器人世界模型与控制范畴

candidates.title: Progress Probes $P^2$: Lightweight Runtime Monitoring for Vision-Language-Action Models
candidates.title_zh: Progress Probes P²：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的轻量级运行时监控
candidates.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform diverse manipulation tasks directly from visual observations and natural language instructions, but they remain prone to mistakes and unpredictable failures. Deploying these policies without continuous human supervision will require robust runtime monitors that detect when the policy has gone off-course. Existing monitors use external foundation models, such as vision-language models (VLMs) to supervise the policy, introducing significant complexity and computational cost for monitoring at runtime. In this work, we investigate an alternate approach: \textit{can a VLA's own internal activations provide the information needed to monitor its execution?} Our method trains linear probes on policy activations from demonstrations to estimate progress, then flags executions that deviate from expected progress. In experiments with the open-source VLA $π_{0.5}$ and across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, this approach is competitive with or outperforms VLM-based monitors in task failure detection, as well as methods which require failure data for training. These findings suggest that simple probes of VLA internals can be used to develop reliable runtime monitors, opening a path toward building policies that can act reliably and monitor their execution without external foundation models.
candidates.summary_zh: 该文在VLA策略内部激活上训练线性进度探针，检测执行偏离并标记失败；在π0.5及仿真和真实操作任务中优于或媲美VLM监控器。
candidates.contribution_zh: 用VLA自身激活实现轻量运行时监控，无需外部基础模型或失败数据，提升机器人操作可靠性。

ai_review.reason: 面向VLA运行时监控与失败检测，直接服务机器人策略可靠执行

candidates.title: Echo: Coupled Action and Task Status Signal Denoising for Vision Language Action Models
candidates.title_zh: Echo：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的耦合动作与任务状态信号去噪
candidates.abstract: Recognizing task completion and failure enables robots to stop upon success and initiate recovery or replanning after failure. Existing methods augment Vision Language Action (VLA) policies with task status signal prediction to support these execution decisions. However, learning and integrating these signals can require fine-grained supervision, external monitoring models, or complex architectural designs. Moreover, the potential of task status signals to directly guide action generation remains underexplored. We present Echo, a framework that combines task status signal learning without frame-level progress annotations with a compact design for status prediction and action generation within a single VLA. Specifically, Echo represents task status with stop and failure signals, added as two dimensions of each action chunk and denoised together with robot actions. Their combination distinguishes ongoing execution, successful completion, and failure. To learn these signals without fine-grained progress annotations, Echo constructs successful, failed, and recovery trajectories with complementary supervision properties. To enable status signal-guided action generation, Echo controls interactions between the signals and actions and denoises the signals faster than the actions. These allow later action denoising steps to condition on cleaner status estimates while preserving accurate signal prediction. Extensive real-world manipulation experiments show that Echo accurately predicts task status and consistently improves policy performance.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出Echo框架，在单一VLA中将停止与失败信号作为动作块附加维度，与动作联合去噪，无需帧级进度标注，并让状态信号更快去噪以引导动作生成，真实机器人操作实验验证有效。
candidates.contribution_zh: 将任务完成/失败信号作为动作块维度联合去噪，构建成功、失败与恢复轨迹监督，并通过更快状态去噪引导VLA动作生成。

ai_review.reason: 面向VLA机器人操作，联合去噪动作与任务状态信号，属具身智能与动作生成。

candidates.title: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
candidates.title_zh: 骨架引导的机器人世界模型潜在动作模型
candidates.abstract: Robot world models simulate how environments evolve in response to robot actions. Latent action models enable learning dynamics from videos by encoding visual transitions as proxy actions. However, reconstruction-driven latent actions mix robot motion with object responses and other scene changes, complicating their correspondence with robot controls. We propose SkeLAM, a skeleton-guided latent action model for controllable robot world modeling. SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into a kinematic component grounded by robot skeleton supervision and a residual component retaining complementary visual dynamics. Cross-modal swap reconstruction encourages RGB-derived and skeleton-derived kinematic representations to be interchangeable during video reconstruction. The world model incorporates both components through separate conditioning pathways, while branch dropout reduces its dependence on future-derived residual information. A lightweight adapter maps robot actions to the kinematic space, and subsequent world-model fine-tuning adapts generation to these predicted conditions. At inference, the model generates future observations from the current observation and robot actions. On DROID, SkeLAM reduces end-effector ADE by 19.5% and LPIPS by 11.1% compared with DreamDojo. Motion probing supports kinematic specialization, while qualitative results demonstrate zero-shot human-to-robot motion transfer in generated rollouts. Policy evaluation shows agreement between predicted success rates and those measured in real robot executions.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出SkeLAM，用机器人骨架监督将潜在动作分解为运动学分量与残差分量，实现由机器人动作可控的未来视频生成与世界建模。
candidates.contribution_zh: 将潜在动作解耦为骨架接地的运动学分量和视觉残差，并以跨模态交换重建与轻量适配器提升动作可控性与零样本迁移。

ai_review.reason: 机器人世界模型与潜在动作建模，直接服务具身控制与策略评估

candidates.title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
candidates.title_zh: PhysTrace：视频生成模型物理一致性的可解释时序评估
candidates.abstract: World action models increasingly rely on pretrained video models assumed to capture physical dynamics for prediction, planning, and action generation. Existing evaluations assess plausibility, probe representations, or measure predictive surprise, but rarely identify which history-conditioned physical expectations conflict with observations. We introduce PhysTrace, a training-free framework aligning MLLM-generated, history-conditioned expectations with observed video windows to temporally localize physical violations and provide interpretable descriptions without task-specific probes or classifiers. We also introduce IntPhys2-Timing, adding violation intervals to IntPhys2. PhysTrace achieves a Hit Rate of up to 70.7% across physical principles on IntPhys2-Timing and outperforms the compared methods in overall possible-impossible discrimination accuracy on IntPhys2. Applied to reconstructed videos along the trajectories of pretrained diffusion/flow-based video models, PhysTrace reveals attribute- and noise-dependent patterns in physical violation localization, enabling interpretable physical consistency analysis across timesteps.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出免训练框架，用MLLM生成历史条件物理预期并与视频窗口对齐，时序定位物理违规并给出可解释描述；构建IntPhys2-Timing，评估视频生成模型的物理一致性。
candidates.contribution_zh: 免训练、可解释地时序定位视频生成中的物理违规，并新增带违规区间的IntPhys2-Timing基准。

provenance.source_comment: 17 pages, 7 figures (including supplementary material). Code: https://github.com/PhysTrace/PhysTrace

ai_review.reason: 评估视频生成模型的物理一致性，直接支撑世界模型与仿真可靠性

candidates.title: FastHarness: Experience-Driven Review Scheduling for Vision-Language-Action Policies
candidates.title_zh: FastHarness：面向视觉-语言-动作策略的经验驱动复核调度
candidates.abstract: Agentic robot systems combine language-model reasoning with robot policies to monitor execution and recover from failures. However, reviewing every action chunk incurs substantial overhead, even in familiar situations. We introduce FastHarness, an experience-driven execution harness that adaptively schedules GPT-6 Astra supervision of a π0.5 policy. A fast path uses stage memory and reviewed outcomes to reduce review frequency as experience accumulates, while a complementary recovery path focuses supervision on correcting errors. Once recovery is verified, routine execution resumes, with failure experience retained to guide future interventions. The policy remains frozen and generates fresh actions from current observations. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, reviewer token use decreases by an average of 57.2% per task from the first evaluated episode to the mean of the final five episodes. Mean episode time decreases from 85.5 to 52.0 minutes over the same interval. On the same tasks, mean success increases from 80% for GPT-as-Policy (π0.5 + GPT-6 Astra) to 97.19% with FastHarness. These results highlight adaptive supervision as a practical route to more efficient agentic robotics without additional model training.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出经验驱动的执行框架，用阶段记忆与复核结果自适应调度大模型对冻结VLA策略的监督，仅在需要时介入纠错，显著降低复核开销并提升成功率。
candidates.contribution_zh: 以经验积累自适应降低复核频率、聚焦恢复纠错，无需额外训练即可提升VLA策略执行效率与成功率。

ai_review.reason: 面向VLA策略的自适应监督调度，直接服务机器人执行与纠错

candidates.title: FocusVLA: Future-Intent Guided Dynamic View Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
candidates.title_zh: FocusVLA：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的前景意图引导动态视角路由
candidates.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become an important paradigm for robotic manipulation by unifying visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Since reliable manipulation requires sufficient observation of objects, end-effectors, and their spatial relationships, multi-view inputs are widely used to provide complementary spatial information. However, our experiments show that existing VLA models do not fully exploit such multi-view complementarity. The policy tends to persistently rely on the wrist view, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust global-local view dependency across manipulation stages, which limits stage adaptability and robustness. To address this issue, we propose FocusVLA, a stage-aware multi-view routing framework. FocusVLA predicts future interaction intent from historical actions and uses it to guide dynamic view routing during action generation. By adaptively coordinating global and local observations across different task stages, FocusVLA improves multi-view utilization. On RoboTwin 2.0, FocusVLA improves the average success rate over the strongest baseline $π_{0.5}$ by 10.10 pp. In real-world evaluation, FocusVLA improves the success rate from 71.7\% to 85.0\%, achieving a 13.3\% gain over $π_{0.5}$. Moreover, the intent prediction and dynamic routing modules of FocusVLA can be integrated into existing VLA frameworks without modifying their core architectures.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出阶段感知多视角路由框架，从历史动作预测未来交互意图，动态协调全局与腕部视角以提升VLA操作成功率。
candidates.contribution_zh: 以未来交互意图引导VLA动态视角路由，提升多视角利用、阶段适应性与真实机器人操作鲁棒性。

ai_review.reason: 聚焦VLA机器人操作，多视角动态路由直接服务动作生成与空间感知，属收录范围。

candidates.title: Inside-JEPA: From Prediction to Relational Grounding in Latent World Models
candidates.title_zh: Inside-JEPA：从预测到潜世界模型中的关系接地
candidates.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models in latent space, enabling efficient planning but leaving their states opaque. We introduce Inside-JEPA, which places relational channels for ordered entity pairs inside the JEPA latent state and shows that an inverse-dynamics loss can ground these channels without relation labels when its head reads them, either alone or as part of the full state. On Something-Something V2, latent prediction alone performs no better than a random relation head, while inverse-dynamics supervision that recovers actions from channel changes improves relational AUROC by .065-.103 across ten settings with annotated boxes, by .081 on RH20T robot episodes with held-out tasks, and by .050-.061 across five relations using off-the-shelf detection and tracking. An inverse head on entity latents decodes actions more accurately but barely improves relational grounding; shuffled labels, two label-free objectives, and action labels on only 5% of the pairs also fail to ground the channels. Given an action, predicted relational changes approach the quality of observed future relations (AUROC .599 vs .621). For one-step relational goals, a supervised readout of the 16 channels ranks the correct action among the top five of 65 in 43% of cases, compared with 24% for prediction-only latents and 17% for a frequency prior.
candidates.summary_zh: 在JEPA潜状态中引入有序实体对关系通道，并证明逆动力学损失可在无关系标签下接地这些通道，提升关系AUROC，并支持动作条件关系预测与目标选择。
candidates.contribution_zh: 将关系通道嵌入JEPA潜状态，用逆动力学监督实现无标签关系接地，并在SSv2与RH20T上验证动作条件关系预测和一步关系目标规划。

ai_review.reason: JEPA潜世界模型与关系接地直接服务机器人规划，予以收录。

candidates.title: Memory before Goal: Role of Pre-History Memory for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
candidates.title_zh: 记忆先于目标：预历史记忆在人形移动操作中的作用
candidates.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation in dynamic scenes is non-Markovian: cues vanish as objects change or are hidden, or leave the view as the robot turns and walks, yet whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies see only the present. We present WholeBodyMem, an object-guided perceptual memory that keeps the pre-history of object events seen before the robot acts on its goal. SAM3 tracks the task objects, and their events causally select key frames within an adaptive budget, which the action expert reads by cross-attention together with object tokens encoding appearance, geometry and time. We also contribute HuMeGo, a humanoid memory benchmark with six simulated and six real-world Unitree G1 tasks. Keeping the right frames rather than more frames, WholeBodyMem surpasses memoryless and uniform-memory baselines, raising its base policy's success from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and from 36.7% to 88.3% on the real robot, while also improving the standard SIMPLE tasks (70.2% to 86.9%).
candidates.summary_zh: 提出WholeBodyMem，以对象引导的感知记忆为全身VLA保留动作前物体事件历史，并构建HuMeGo人形记忆基准，在仿真与真实G1上显著提升任务成功率。
candidates.contribution_zh: 对象引导预历史记忆、因果关键帧选择与跨注意力读取，配合人形记忆基准，提升非马尔可夫移动操作。

provenance.source_comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Project page: https://memory-before-goal.github.io

candidates.title: Dual Exam: Controlled Evaluation of Multimodal Agents and World Models
candidates.title_zh: Dual Exam：多模态智能体与世界模型的受控评估
candidates.abstract: World Models (WMs) can support Multimodal Agents (MAs) through simulated experience, while Agent trajectories can inform World Model refinement. Evaluating this interaction requires separate evidence about action selection and state evolution. We introduce Dual Exam, which tests Agents under fixed environment response mechanisms and World Models under fixed action interventions across physical, digital, social, and scientific domains. The Agent track compares 10 configurations on 1,088 items in 15 reporting categories. The World Model track contains 400 cases across eight scenarios; 15 configurations have full coverage and one covers six scenarios. GPT 6 Astra leads the case-weighted Agent Index at 31.3, and GPT-Image-2 leads the full-coverage WM Overall at 21.7. These scores use different tasks and metrics and are not directly comparable. A 150-case pilot of one coupled pairing records zero task successes and motivates component-level diagnosis. Results reveal uneven task performance and failures to preserve task-relevant state. Their value for predicting coupled success or sustained reciprocal learning remains to be established.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出 Dual Exam 基准，在物理、数字、社交、科学领域分别受控评估多模态智能体与世界模型；含1088项智能体任务和400个世界模型案例，揭示任务表现不均与状态保持失败。
candidates.contribution_zh: 构建分离评估智能体动作选择与世界模型状态演化的受控基准，并初步检验二者耦合，发现现有配置成功率低。

candidates.title: In-Context Learning World Models for Robot Dual-Arm Manipulation of Soft Garment with Partial Observations
candidates.title_zh: 面向部分观测下双臂软衣物操作的情境学习世界模型
candidates.abstract: Robust manipulation of soft objects, such as garments, is a critical skill for service and household robots to adopt, but remains challenging due to its high-dimensional state space, and material-dependent deformations. Humans address this challenge by using mental world models that "imagine" the shape and material properties from partial observations, which enables them to predict how actions affect future states. As such, embedding such world models in robots allows for better generalization in manipulating a wide variety of garments in the real world. However, learned world models typically require large amounts of real world data that is strenuous to collect, and a mechanism to infer latent properties that govern dynamics. We present a Soft-Object World Model that performs generative full-state estimation and action-conditioned dynamics prediction using a transformer backbone trained on large-scale simulated soft object interactions, with measures to mitigate the sim-to-real gap. By learning to infer latent shape and material cues through in-context learning over a variable-length partial point-cloud history, the model generalizes across robot embodiments, material parameters, garment types and shapes, and manipulation coordination modes without weight updates. The world model is then integrated with a Goal-Conditioned action planner for motion synthesis. We validate the approach in simulation and real world for bimanual garment folding, reporting improvements in reconstruction fidelity, prediction accuracy, and task success.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出软物体世界模型：以Transformer从变长部分点云历史中情境学习推断形状与材质隐变量，实现生成式全状态估计与动作条件动力学预测，并结合目标条件规划器完成双臂衣物折叠。
candidates.contribution_zh: 用情境学习从部分点云历史推断隐形状与材质，无需权重更新即可跨本体、材质与衣物类型泛化；仿真大规模训练并缓解虚实差距，仿真与真机折叠任务均提升重建、预测与成功率。

ai_review.reason: 软体衣物双臂操作的具身世界模型，含动作条件动力学预测与规划，切题

candidates.title: Measuring the Reasoning-Action Coupling in Driving Vision-Language-Action Models through Counterfactuals
candidates.title_zh: 通过反事实测量驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型中的推理—动作耦合
candidates.abstract: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models bring an appealing form of explainability to a safety-critical domain, since a system that can state the reasons for its maneuvers offers the transparency that deployment and public trust in autonomous driving demand. These models read the world into language before they act on it, describing the scene and reasoning over it in text that ranges from chain-of-thought to multi-stage question answering on the way to a trajectory. That framing quietly assumes two separable properties, namely that the trajectory follows the generated reasoning and that the generated reasoning tracks the causes that actually produce the trajectory. To thoroughly investigate these properties, we apply causal, counterfactual interventions to four driving VLAs across different benchmarks. First, we perturb the models' own reasoning and show that altering its meaning produces small trajectory changes relative to blanking the same models' camera inputs, a pattern that persists across benchmarks and model architectures. We then construct scene-level counterfactuals through photorealistic removal of key objects named in the models' reasoning and analyze whether the generated reasoning and trajectories track these changes. Overall, our findings indicate that the reasoning these models present to account for their resulting driving behavior is weakly coupled to that behavior itself, pointing to limits on the explainability these systems are intended to provide.
candidates.summary_zh: 对四个驾驶VLA施加因果反事实干预：改写模型自身推理、逼真移除推理中提及的关键物体，并比较轨迹变化。结果显示推理对轨迹的影响远小于遮挡相机输入，推理与行为弱耦合。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提出以反事实干预量化驾驶VLA推理—动作耦合的评测方法，揭示其文本推理对轨迹的因果影响微弱，可解释性存疑。

candidates.title: DRILL: Training World Models to Improve Policies, Not Predict Pixels
candidates.title_zh: DRILL：训练世界模型以改进策略，而非预测像素
candidates.abstract: World models are increasingly used to reduce environment interaction when post-training vision-language-action (VLA) policies with reinforcement learning. Yet they are typically trained to predict pixels one step ahead, even though their role here is not merely to render visually faithful videos but to produce learning signals from imagined rollouts that improve the policy. We show that this mismatch is substantial: lower pixel MSE can produce worse policy gradients, and a world model trained for policy utility can yield better downstream policies despite 17% higher pixel MSE on the next frame. We propose the Downstream-Return Imagination Learning Loop (DRILL), a bilevel framework that updates the world model to maximize the policy's return after an inner GRPO update on imagined rollouts. DRILL has two instantiations. DRILL-VWI is a closed-form surrogate, requiring no additional simulator rollouts, that reweights prediction errors by policy visitation, the group-relative GRPO advantage, and model confidence. DRILL-IMG is a full meta-gradient method that differentiates through the inner update using truncated Hessian-vector products. We show that DRILL-VWI recovers the local one-step component of the DRILL-IMG meta-gradient under score-compatibility and small-residual assumptions. Across five manipulation simulators and two VLA backbones, DRILL-IMG raises mean success rate by 13.1 points over WMPO and 7.9 points over RLVR-World, and complements RLVR pretraining rather than competing with it. More broadly, we believe video world models for VLA reinforcement learning can be productively trained by the policy gradients they produce, not only by pixel-level prediction.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出DRILL双层框架，用想象rollout上策略更新后的回报训练世界模型，而非单步像素预测，并在多种操作仿真与VLA主干上验证策略提升。
candidates.contribution_zh: 将世界模型训练目标改为下游策略回报，给出闭式DRILL-VWI与元梯度DRILL-IMG两种实现，提升VLA强化学习效果。

ai_review.reason: 面向VLA强化学习的世界模型训练，属具身智能与动作条件预测核心范围

candidates.title: An Introduction to World Models for Generalist Agents
candidates.title_zh: 面向通用智能体的世界模型导论
candidates.abstract: World models have recently emerged as a promising direction toward developing generalist agents capable of understanding, predicting, and interacting with diverse environments. However, despite growing interest, the concept of a world model remains loosely defined, encompassing approaches ranging from predictive dynamics models and learned simulators to models that jointly generate future observations and actions. This introductory paper aims to clarify the concept of world models and provide a unified perspective on their role in developing generalist agents. Starting from the partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) framework, we connect world modeling to classical control, dynamical systems, signal processing, and reinforcement learning. We introduce different approaches to world modeling, emphasizing the knowledge they capture, their learning objectives, and how they support decision-making. We further explore the relationship between world modeling and policy learning, highlighting how these capabilities can be unified through conditional prediction without requiring separate models. Rather than offering an exhaustive survey of existing methods, this paper focuses on fundamental concepts, modeling principles, and connections, with the goal of providing an accessible and unified introduction to world models for generalist agents.
candidates.summary_zh: 从POMDP出发统一梳理世界模型的概念、学习目标及其与经典控制、动力系统和强化学习的联系，讨论世界建模与策略学习如何通过条件预测统一，为通用智能体提供入门性框架。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提供统一视角，澄清世界模型定义，连接控制、动力系统与强化学习，并阐述条件预测统一建模与决策的路径。

ai_review.reason: 世界模型与智能体决策直接相关，虽偏导论但属物理智能基础范畴。

candidates.title: DeXplicit: Making Physical State Explicit in Dexterous Manipulation World Models
candidates.title_zh: DeXplicit：在灵巧操作世界模型中显式表达物理状态
candidates.abstract: Before acting on an object, a robot needs to anticipate how its hand motion will change the physical world and what the resulting scene will look like. Existing approaches typically entangle action-conditioned dynamics, camera motion, and visual synthesis within a video generation model, or represent dynamics as point trajectories without explicit object structure. We introduce DeXplicit, a dexterous manipulation world model that instead predicts how the world evolves explicitly in metric 3D before rendering its visual consequences. Given an initial scene and a future hand trajectory, a lightweight 3D dynamics network predicts object-centric motion and deformation, providing structured and geometrically grounded future world states. These predictions then serve as a strong scaffold for video generation: appearance is transported through the predicted 3D motion and projected into future views, allowing the renderer to focus on completing uncertain and newly visible content rather than implicitly learning world dynamics from pixels. This explicit-3D-first decomposition also enables efficient causal generation, requiring only two denoising steps per block while conditioning on generated history. Across HOT3D, OakInk2, and PhysTwin, DeXplicit reduces moved-point error by 27-40% relative to PointWorld and improves object fidelity IoU+ by 47% on HOT3D under a shared renderer. Our design with two-step causal generation achieves a 57x speedup from our 14B bi-directional configuration in video synthesis.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出灵巧操作世界模型，先用轻量三维动力学网络显式预测物体运动与形变，再以其为支架渲染未来视频；在多数据集上降低运动点误差并大幅加速生成。
candidates.contribution_zh: 将世界模型分解为显式度量三维动力学预测与外观渲染，以预测三维运动引导视频生成，并支持两步因果高效生成。

ai_review.reason: 面向灵巧操作的動作条件世界模型，显式预测三维物理状态并渲染未来场景，属机器人世界模型核心范畴。

candidates.title: SmolVLA-MoE: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Multi-Task Robotic Manipulation
candidates.title_zh: SmolVLA-MoE：面向高效多任务机器人操作的稀疏混合专家模型
candidates.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in multi-task robotic manipulation by leveraging visual and language understanding for action generation. However, existing lightweight VLA models employ a single dense action expert to handle all tasks, which limits their multi-task capability under constrained computational budgets. To address this issue, we propose SmolVLA-MoE, a novel framework that introduces sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) into the FFN layers of the action expert in VLA models. SmolVLA-MoE replaces dense FFN layers with multiple parallel expert FFNs and a token-level router, enabling each token to adaptively select the most suitable expert for action generation. We further introduce a shared expert with a tunable weight parameter to balance the inheritance of pre-trained capabilities and task-specific expert specialization. Through sparse activation, SmolVLA-MoE activates only a single expert FFN during inference, with a total activated parameter count of approximately 500M including the frozen VLM backbone, while benefiting from approximately 800M total stored parameters. We evaluate our method on four task suites of the LIBERO benchmark. SmolVLA-MoE achieves an average success rate of 84.25%, outperforming SmolVLA (82.75%) and OpenVLA-7B (76.5%), while maintaining comparable inference efficiency. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/dudu435/smolvla-moe.
candidates.summary_zh: 将稀疏混合专家引入VLA动作专家FFN，以token级路由选择专家并用共享专家平衡预训练与任务特化；LIBERO四任务平均成功率84.25%，优于SmolVLA和OpenVLA-7B。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提出SmolVLA-MoE，将稀疏MoE与共享专家引入轻量VLA动作专家，实现单专家稀疏激活的多任务机器人操作。

candidates.title: Learning from Next-Frame Prediction: Towards Unified and Scalable Visual Representation Learning
candidates.title_zh: 通过下一帧预测学习：迈向统一且可扩展的视觉表征学习
candidates.abstract: Video provides a natural source of supervision: what happens next serves as a learning signal for visual world modeling. Yet masked video pretraining focuses on recovering missing content from surrounding context rather than predicting the future from the past. Autoregressive methods instead predict forward one token at a time, but have yet to match joint-embedding methods in representation quality. This gap motivates us to revisit the granularity and space of future prediction. In this work, we introduce VANE, a self-supervised visual pretraining framework built on next-frame prediction in embedding space. A causal encoder summarizes past observations for a state predictor that infers the representation of the entire next frame, making temporal evolution the primary learning signal. This prediction is carried out in a fixed embedding space provided by a frozen semantic tokenizer, emphasizing scene content and structure. To retain fine-grained spatial detail alongside semantic content, a lightweight auxiliary generative decoder reconstructs future-frame patches conditioned on the predicted representations. To unify visual modeling across images and videos, we construct a local-to-global crop sequence for still images, allowing the same encoder to predict newly revealed regions from earlier crops under the same objective. Experiments show that VANE improves with model and data scaling, achieving SOTA on most anticipation, recognition, and dense perception benchmarks among unified encoders. Especially on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 action anticipation, it surpasses V-JEPA 2.1 by 7.1 points in mean-class recall@5. These results demonstrate that next-frame prediction in embedding space is effective and scalable for visual world modeling.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出 VANE：在冻结的语义分词器嵌入空间中做下一帧预测，因果编码器汇总过去，状态预测器推断整帧表征，并辅以轻量生成解码器恢复空间细节；在动作预测等基准上超越 V-JEPA 2.1。
candidates.contribution_zh: 以嵌入空间下一帧预测作为主学习信号，替代掩码重建与逐 token 自回归，并用裁剪序列统一图像与视频预训练。

ai_review.reason: 视频下一帧嵌入预测是视觉世界模型的基础方法，与 JEPA 路线直接相关；虽无机器人实验，仍应收录。

candidates.title: Anticipating Social Consequences with Distributional World Models
candidates.title_zh: 用分布式世界模型预判社会后果
candidates.abstract: Social world models predict how interactions develop after an action, helping agents negotiate, cooperate and mediate. In these situations, one action can lead to several plausible futures, hence predicting only one future can overlook consequential alternatives, while exploring them through repeated simulations increases inference cost. We propose DSWM, a Distributional Social World Model that predicts alternative responses, their probabilities and immediate and final outcome values in one output per candidate action. We train a 4B model on repeated simulations using supervised fine-tuning and GRPO. At inference time, the actor uses these possible consequences to choose an action. Across three seen and two unseen environments, with interaction backbones absent from training collection, DSWM achieves the best average performance on 13 of 15 metrics. Ablations show that retaining multiple futures and their predicted probabilities improves outcomes in all five environments.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出DSWM分布式社会世界模型，对每个候选动作一次性输出多种可能回应、其概率及即时与最终结果价值，用SFT与GRPO训练4B模型，推理时据此选择动作，在五个社交环境中多数指标最优。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提出一次性预测多未来及其概率的分布式社会世界模型，用于社交交互中的动作选择。

ai_review.reason: 社交交互世界模型，面向谈判协作，非具身或物理智能

candidates.title: From Single-Actor Environments to Multi-Actor Event Worlds: Can LLMs Be Event World Models?
candidates.title_zh: 从单主体环境到多主体事件世界：LLM能否成为事件世界模型？
candidates.abstract: World models help agents assess the consequences of their actions before acting. Many real systems, however, involve multiple actors who make their own decisions, can evolve even when the agent takes no action, and are only partially observed through event logs. We formalize these systems as event worlds and ask whether large language models can predict future observations from the log and the agent's proposed actions. We build complementary benchmarks from human Diplomacy games and real Polymarket trades. Our hierarchical framework compares prediction with and without other actors' actions, then tests multi-step rollouts, predictions for actions never taken, and usefulness to agents. Fine-tuning and more data improve prediction when all actors' recorded actions are given. With only the agent's action, models struggle when other actors strongly affect the outcome, and larger models and longer histories help little. This gap also limits multi-step prediction and agent decisions, with models overestimating plan success. Yet imagined experience and initialization from world models can still improve policy learning. Anticipating other actors' actions remains a central challenge for event world modeling.
candidates.summary_zh: 论文将多主体事件系统形式化为事件世界，基于外交游戏和Polymarket交易构建基准，评估LLM能否根据日志与智能体动作预测未来观测，并测试多步推演与策略学习。
candidates.contribution_zh: 提出事件世界形式化与多主体预测基准，比较有无他人动作时的LLM预测，并分析其对多步预测和智能体决策的影响。

ai_review.reason: 研究多主体事件日志预测，使用外交游戏与预测市场，非机器人或物理智能，建议拒绝。

candidates.title: Tactile-Based Robotic Manipulation: From Mechanics-Driven to Data-Driven Perspectives
candidates.title_zh: 基于触觉的机器人操作：从力学驱动到数据驱动视角
candidates.abstract: Tactile sensing provides robots with direct access to physical interactions at the contact interface, making it a critical modality for robust and dexterous manipulation. Over the past several decades, tactile-based manipulation research has evolved from mechanics-driven approaches, which explicitly interpret tactile signals through contact mechanics and task-specific reasoning, to data-driven approaches that learn tactile representations and manipulation policies directly from data. This paper reviews the development of tactile-based manipulation from these two complementary perspectives. We first introduce the fundamentals of tactile sensing, and then review, from a mechanics-driven perspective, how those signals form manipulation-relevant state representations and subsequently influence the robot action. We then examine the recent advances in data-driven tactile manipulation, covering imitation learning, reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, and predictive models. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future opportunities toward scalable, generalizable, and robust tactile-enabled robotic systems.
candidates.summary_zh: 综述触觉机器人操作从接触力学建模到数据驱动学习的演进，涵盖触觉表征、模仿与强化学习、视觉语言动作模型及预测模型，并讨论开放挑战。
candidates.contribution_zh: 系统梳理力学驱动与数据驱动两条触觉操作路线，归纳学习范式与未来方向。

candidates.title: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
candidates.title_zh: 面向世界动作模型的自蒸馏未来视频表示学习
candidates.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising approach to learning generalist robot policies using rich spatiotemporal priors from pre-trained video diffusion models. A recent line of WAMs improves inference efficiency by conditioning a separate action decoder on intermediate future video representations extracted from a single denoising step, avoiding costly iterative denoising required for video generation. This design makes action prediction depend directly on the quality of these future representations. In this paper, we introduce Future REpresentation learning via self-Distillation with temporal context (FRED), a framework that trains WAMs to improve the quality of future video representations from noise in a single denoising step. Specifically, FRED uses self-distillation to predict future representations from noise, using representations extracted from ground-truth future observations as targets. We further condition the video model on historical observations, providing temporal context for predicting future representations better. Across diverse real-world manipulation scenarios, FRED consistently outperforms competing WAMs. It achieves particularly large gains on long-horizon and out-of-domain tasks under zero-shot environment generalization, and substantially improves human-to-robot skill transfer, reaching 50.0% task success on tasks absent from robot training data and demonstrated only in human videos, compared with 19.4% for the best competing WAM.
candidates.summary_zh: 提出FRED，通过自蒸馏从单步去噪噪声中预测未来视频表示，并以历史观测为时序上下文，提升世界动作模型的动作预测质量与泛化能力。
candidates.contribution_zh: 以真实未来观测表示为目标自蒸馏未来表示，并引入历史时序上下文；在真实机器人操作、长程零样本泛化及人类视频到机器人迁移上显著提升。

topics: 人类到机器人技能迁移
